# Public native witnessed histories

The native-pass/fail/no-effect/cleanup-pending/witness-death/runner-death/cancelled bundles
contain actual development Kind executions from T4.3. They were collected by
separate real source-observer, witness and runner processes, with real HTTP
dependency delays, original control receipts and independent signed timings.
The interrupted cases retain signed prefixes and missing original results.

The bundled publisher and witness policy files are explicit regression-test roots.
Their presence does not provision real operator trust. Tests select a fixed clock
inside each policy's validity window. No private key, grant, kubeconfig or runtime
inventory is included. These are development measurements, not claims of a final
release or independent hardware/machine attestation. Final milestone evidence is
collected separately against the frozen source. The external execution evidence
retains source snapshots, exact child exits and fixture provenance hashes.
